title: codetospec registry
description: The PIP's registry, a person's (policy.ParseRegistry): each property, relation and attribute a policy reads, what it is built from, and how a person reads it. Also the glossary the business statements are written with. JSON, or the same document in YAML.

from.description: What it is built from: struct fields (models.Classroom.AllTeacherKaids), datastore kinds ("load UserMetaInfo"), methods ("models.Classroom.HasTeacher()").

condition.description: Free text the inventory shows but never evaluates.

phrase.description: The plain wording a business statement uses for it, by language (en, fr): "teaches the class".

concept.description: The domain concept it belongs to (a domain-model or code entity): Classroom.

note.description: More on the entry, for people.
